tasks.description: Upgrade to Java 25 and Spring Boot 4.x
tasks.reason: Migrate to the latest LTS versions to benefit from long-term support, improved performance, security patches, and modern language features.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade JDK to 25, Spring Boot to 4.x, Spring Framework to 7.x, and migrate javax.* to jakarta.* namespaces where applicable. Ensure all dependencies are compatible with the target versions.
tasks.summary: Upgraded from Java 11 / Spring Boot 2.7.14 to Java 25 / Spring Boot 4.0.0 (Spring Framework 7.0.1) via an intermediate step at Spring Boot 3.3.13 / Java 17. Key changes: javax.* → jakarta.* namespace migration; SimpleRabbitListenerContainerFactoryConfigurer moved to new package; JacksonJsonMessageConverter replacing Jackson2JsonMessageConverter for Jackson 3.x; spring-retry 2.0.12 added explicitly; Lombok added to annotationProcessorPaths. Build: SUCCESS, Tests: 1/1 passed with JDK 25.
